dataset: Woolsey Fire 2018 unified-command incident update bulletins (LA County Fire archive), curated status extracts
interpretation: Each bulletin lists conditions in effect at its stated report time. Status rows are recorded at the bulletin time with time_role 'listed_in_status_bulletin'; the bulletin does not establish when a closure, order or capacity condition began. A bulletin dated 7:00 p.m. on 11/12 states US-101 openings at 2100 and 2200, but its PDF CreationDate is 2018-11-12 19:15 PST, so those openings are recorded as announced times, not observed transitions. Earliest archived bulletin found is 11/10 7:00 p.m.; 11/08-11/10 AM bulletins returned HTTP 404 at the guessed archive paths.
